summary: Carlyle Credit Income Fund filed a routine 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing management's unaudited net asset value per common share of $3.23 as of August 31, 2026. The filing was signed by Principal Financial Officer Nelson Joseph on September 15, 2026. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or structural mechanics are present. The closed-end fund also lists preferred shares (CCID) alongside common shares (CCIF) on the NYSE. This is a periodic NAV disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies beyond ordinary NAV discount/premium monitoring.
